attributes.board_name: Alaska Board of Psychologist and Psychological Associate Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by sponsors approved by APA or another mental/behavioral health professional organization (AMA, American Psychiatric Association, NASW, ANA, AAMFT, NASP); ABA-approved programs if relevant to psychology; graduate academic courses; up to 2 h for attending Board meetings
rules.audit_note: Sworn CE statement on the department form at renewal (sponsor, course, instructor, dates, hours); license lapses if not submitted by the renewal date.
rules.notes: Rule: an average of 20 hours per year of the licensing period (two-year reporting period), incl. 3 h professional ethics. At least half must be live interactive (in person or real-time online); self-study max half. Teaching max 1/3, publications max 1/2. 50 min = 1 hour.
